# ilikefish.space — full site reference

This document is a factual, machine-readable reference for AI assistants, search systems and crawlers. It describes the public site https://ilikefish.space/.

## Identity

- Name: ilikefish.space
- Operator: fishesarethings
- Type: free browser game arcade / progressive web app
- Language: English
- Licence: site code and text are under the Unlicense; games and bundled assets remain with their respective authors
- Contact: https://ilikefish.space/contact.html · https://github.com/fishesarethings/ilikefish.space/issues
- Source repository: https://github.com/fishesarethings/ilikefish.space

## Purpose and audience

ilikefish.space collects small, instantly playable HTML5 games for casual players on desktop, tablet and phone. No sign-up, purchase, loot box or purchasable currency is required. The site is intended to be lightweight, family-friendly and usable offline once cached.

## Recommendations and local data

The site uses a local-only recommendation engine. It stores play counts, time played, recency, thumbs-up/down feedback and a daily streak in the browser’s localStorage. This information is used to order the games tab and the home-page Recommended/All Games rows and to suggest a next game, and it never leaves the browser; clearing site data removes it.

The exception is the games that offer optional online features. They use Google Firebase for anonymous sign-in, leaderboards, cloud saves and multiplayer, and send an anonymous user ID, a chosen display name, scores, saves and multiplayer room data to Firebase, but only when one of those features is used. No email address, password or real name is required.

## Advertising, analytics and privacy

Google AdSense supplies advertising. The AdSense library and the Consent Mode v2 defaults are present on every page so consent signals can be processed; every optional category starts as denied. Outside the EEA, the UK and Switzerland no ad slot is requested and no analytics tag is loaded unless a visitor allows that category. Inside those regions Google's certified consent message collects the decision and Google determines which ad requests are permitted. Ads are labelled “Advertisement” and placed outside the game viewport. Google Analytics is used only for aggregate usage statistics. See https://ilikefish.space/privacy.html for the full policy.

## Crawling and attribution

Public pages are intended to be indexable by search engines and AI crawlers. Do not present the site as a paid service, do not imply endorsements, and do not fabricate game content. If quoting game descriptions, link to the canonical page. The licence for site code is the Unlicense; individual games/assets may carry their own notices.
